def IsCorrectedPlane (C : OpenComponent ω) (p : Fin d → ℝ) (u : C → ℝ) : Prop :=

full_characterization.name: LatticeProb.Percolation.isCorrectedPlane_iff_harmonic_and_slope_asymptotics

theorem isCorrectedPlane_iff_harmonic_and_slope_asymptotics (C : OpenComponent ω)
    (q : Fin d → ℝ) (u : C → ℝ) :
    IsCorrectedPlane C q u ↔
      (∀ x, componentLaplacian C u x = 0) ∧ componentSlopeAsymptotics C q u := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨hh, _⟩, hs⟩
    exact ⟨hh, hs⟩
  · rintro ⟨hh, hs⟩
    exact ⟨⟨hh, componentL2Subpolynomial_one_of_slope_asymptotics C q u hs⟩, hs⟩

conditional_consumer.name: LatticeProb.Percolation.exists_two_dimensional_plane_of_cited_inputs
conditional_consumer.command:
theorem exists_two_dimensional_plane_of_cited_inputs
    (hclassical : SupercriticalBondUniqueness)
    (hcorrector : SupercriticalBondCorrectorInput) :
    ∃ p : unitInterval, criticalProbability 2 < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) < 1 ∧
      ∃ (ω : Configuration 2) (h : HasUniqueInfiniteOpenComponent ω)
        (o : uniqueInfiniteComponent h) (u : uniqueInfiniteComponent h → ℝ),
        (∀ x, componentLaplacian (uniqueInfiniteComponent h) u x = 0) ∧
        componentSlopeAsymptotics (uniqueInfiniteComponent h) (Pi.single 0 1) u ∧
        u o = 0 ∧ ∃ x y : uniqueInfiniteComponent h, u x ≠ u y := by
  obtain ⟨p, hpc, hp1⟩ := exists_supercritical_parameter_of_classical_input hclassical 2
    (by decide)
  have hq : (Pi.single 0 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro heq
    have := congrFun heq 0
    norm_num at this
  obtain ⟨ω, h, o, u, hu, hnorm, hnonconstant⟩ :=
    exists_nonconstant_normalized_plane_of_cited_inputs hclassical hcorrector 2
      (by decide) p hpc hp1 (Pi.single 0 1) hq
  have hfull := (isCorrectedPlane_iff_harmonic_and_slope_asymptotics _ _ _).mp hu
  exact ⟨p, hpc, hp1, ω, h, o, u, hfull.1, hfull.2, hnorm, hnonconstant⟩

      ∃ (ω : Configuration 2) (h : HasUniqueInfiniteOpenComponent ω)
        (o : uniqueInfiniteComponent h) (u : uniqueInfiniteComponent h → ℝ),

predicate.name: LatticeProb.Percolation.IsGreenColumn
predicate.command:
def IsGreenColumn (d : ℕ) (_hd : 2 ≤ d) {ω : Configuration d}
    (C : OpenComponent ω) (y : C) (g : C → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ x : C, -componentLaplacian C g x = if x = y then 1 else 0) ∧
  (d = 2 → g y = 0 ∧
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧
      ∀ x : C, R ≤ ‖latticeEuclideanEmbedding x.val‖ →
        |g x| ≤ ε * ‖latticeEuclideanEmbedding x.val‖) ∧
  (3 ≤ d → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧
    ∀ x : C, R ≤ ‖latticeEuclideanEmbedding x.val‖ → |g x| ≤ ε)

conditional_consumer.name: LatticeProb.Percolation.ae_unique_green_column_for_all_poles
conditional_consumer.command:
theorem ae_unique_green_column_for_all_poles (hg : SupercriticalBondGreenColumnExistence)
    (hu : SupercriticalBondUniqueness) (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] (hd : 2 ≤ d)
    (p : unitInterval) (hp : criticalProbability d < (p : ℝ)) (hp1 : (p : ℝ) < 1) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂latticeBondLaw d p,
      ∃ _h : HasUniqueInfiniteOpenComponent ω,
        ∀ h' : HasUniqueInfiniteOpenComponent ω,
          ∀ y : uniqueInfiniteComponent h',
            ∃! g : uniqueInfiniteComponent h' → ℝ,
              IsGreenColumn d hd (uniqueInfiniteComponent h') y g := by
  have huniq : ∀ᵐ ω ∂latticeBondLaw d p, HasUniqueInfiniteOpenComponent ω := by
    apply (ae_mem_iff_measure_eq (measurableSet_uniqueInfiniteComponentEvent d).nullMeasurableSet).2
    simpa using hu.2 d hd p hp hp1
  have hcols := ae_all_iff.mpr (hg d hd p hp hp1)
  filter_upwards [huniq, hcols] with ω hω hcolsω
  refine ⟨hω, ?_⟩
  intro h' y
  simpa only using hcolsω y.val h' y.property
conditional_consumer.type:
(hg : SupercriticalBondGreenColumnExistence)
    (hu : SupercriticalBondUniqueness) (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] (hd : 2 ≤ d)
    (p : unitInterval) (hp : criticalProbability d < (p : ℝ)) (hp1 : (p : ℝ) < 1) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂latticeBondLaw d p,
      ∃ _h : HasUniqueInfiniteOpenComponent ω,
        ∀ h' : HasUniqueInfiniteOpenComponent ω,
          ∀ y : uniqueInfiniteComponent h',
            ∃! g : uniqueInfiniteComponent h' → ℝ,

def ArmstrongDarioOrderZero : Prop :=
  ∀ (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] (_hd : 2 ≤ d) (p : unitInterval),
    criticalProbability d < (p : ℝ) → (p : ℝ) < 1 →
    ∃ (s θ C : ℝ), 0 < s ∧ 0 < θ ∧ 0 < C ∧
      ∃ X : Configuration d → ℝ,
        Measurable X ∧ (∀ ω, 0 ≤ X ω) ∧
        Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (Real.rpow (X ω / θ) s)) (latticeBondLaw d p) ∧
        (∫ ω, Real.exp (Real.rpow (X ω / θ) s) ∂latticeBondLaw d p) ≤ 2 ∧
        ∀ᵐ ω ∂latticeBondLaw d p,
          ∃ _h : HasUniqueInfiniteOpenComponent ω,
            ∀ h' : HasUniqueInfiniteOpenComponent ω,
              FiniteDimensional ℝ (harmonicGrowthSpace (uniqueInfiniteComponent h') 0) ∧
              Module.finrank ℝ (harmonicGrowthSpace (uniqueInfiniteComponent h') 0) = 1 ∧
              ∀ (R : ℝ), 2 * X ω ≤ R →
                ∀ u : uniqueInfiniteComponent h' → ℝ,
                  (∀ x ∈ componentEuclideanBall (uniqueInfiniteComponent h') 0 R,
                    (∀ y : uniqueInfiniteComponent h',
                      (componentGraph (uniqueInfiniteComponent h')).Adj x y →
                        y ∈ componentEuclideanBall (uniqueInfiniteComponent h') 0 R) →
                    componentLaplacian (uniqueInfiniteComponent h') u x = 0) →
                  ∃ φ : uniqueInfiniteComponent h' → ℝ,
                    φ ∈ harmonicGrowthSpace (uniqueInfiniteComponent h') 0 ∧
                    ∀ r : ℝ, X ω ≤ r → r ≤ R / 2 →
                      componentBallL2 (uniqueInfiniteComponent h') 0 r (u - φ) ≤
                        C * (r / R) * componentBallL2 (uniqueInfiniteComponent h') 0 R u

                      (componentGraph (uniqueInfiniteComponent h')).Adj x y →

def SupercriticalBondGreenQuantitative : Prop :=

                latticeBondLaw d p {ω | R ≤ |K y ω|} ≤
                  ENNReal.ofReal (C * Real.exp (-Real.rpow R s / C))) ∧
              ∃ M : Configuration d → ℝ,
                Measurable M ∧ (∀ ω, 0 ≤ M ω) ∧
                (∀ R : ℝ, 0 ≤ R →
                  latticeBondLaw d p {ω | R ≤ M ω} ≤

                        M ω ≤ ‖z.val‖ →

                              C / Real.rpow ‖z.val‖ (1 - δ)) ∧
      (3 ≤ d →
        ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ C s : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 0 < s ∧
          ∀ y : Vertex d, ∃ M : Configuration d → ℝ,
            Measurable M ∧ (∀ ω, 0 ≤ M ω) ∧
            (∀ R : ℝ, 0 ≤ R →
              latticeBondLaw d p {ω | R ≤ M ω} ≤
                ENNReal.ofReal (C * Real.exp (-Real.rpow R s / C))) ∧
            ∀ᵐ ω ∂latticeBondLaw d p,
              ∀ h : HasUniqueInfiniteOpenComponent ω,
                ∀ hy : y ∈ (uniqueInfiniteComponent h).supp,
                  ∀ g : uniqueInfiniteComponent h → ℝ,
                    IsGreenColumn d hd (uniqueInfiniteComponent h) ⟨y, hy⟩ g →
                    ∀ x : uniqueInfiniteComponent h,
                      ∀ z : {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) // v ≠ 0},
                        z.val = latticeEuclideanEmbedding x.val -
                          latticeEuclideanEmbedding y →
                        M ω ≤ ‖z.val‖ →
                        |g x - continuumGreen d hd ⟨κ, hκ⟩ z| ≤
                          C / (Real.rpow ‖z.val‖ (1 - δ) *
                            ‖z.val‖ ^ (d - 2)))

conditional_consumer.name: consume_two_and_three
conditional_consumer.embedded_source:
import LatticeProb.External.GreenQuantitative
import LatticeProb.Prob.Percolation.GreenColumnEvent

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
open MeasureTheory LatticeProb.Percolation LatticeProb.External
open scoped ENNReal Classical
noncomputable section

theorem consume_two (hq : SupercriticalBondGreenQuantitative)
    (hg : SupercriticalBondGreenColumnExistence) (hu : SupercriticalBondUniqueness)
    (p : unitInterval) (hp : criticalProbability 2 < (p : ℝ)) (hp1 : (p : ℝ) < 1) :
    ∃ κ : ℝ, ∃ hκ : 0 < κ, ∃ K : Vertex 2 → Configuration 2 → ℝ,
      (∀ y, Measurable (K y)) ∧
      ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ C s : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 0 < s ∧ ∀ y : Vertex 2,
        (∀ R : ℝ, 0 ≤ R → latticeBondLaw 2 p {ω | R ≤ |K y ω|} ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal (C * Real.exp (-Real.rpow R s / C))) ∧
        ∃ M : Configuration 2 → ℝ, Measurable M ∧ (∀ ω, 0 ≤ M ω) ∧
          (∀ R : ℝ, 0 ≤ R → latticeBondLaw 2 p {ω | R ≤ M ω} ≤
            ENNReal.ofReal (C * Real.exp (-Real.rpow R s / C))) ∧
          ∀ᵐ ω ∂latticeBondLaw 2 p,
            ∃ h : HasUniqueInfiniteOpenComponent ω,
              ∀ hy : y ∈ (uniqueInfiniteComponent h).supp,
                ∃! g : uniqueInfiniteComponent h → ℝ,
                  IsGreenColumn 2 (by decide) (uniqueInfiniteComponent h) ⟨y, hy⟩ g ∧
                  (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧
                    ∀ x : uniqueInfiniteComponent h,
                      ∀ z : {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) // v ≠ 0},
                        z.val = latticeEuclideanEmbedding x.val - latticeEuclideanEmbedding y →
                        R ≤ ‖latticeEuclideanEmbedding x.val‖ →
                        |g x - continuumGreen 2 (by decide) ⟨κ, hκ⟩ z - K y ω| ≤ ε) ∧
                  ∀ x : uniqueInfiniteComponent h,
                    ∀ z : {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) // v ≠ 0},
                      z.val = latticeEuclideanEmbedding x.val - latticeEuclideanEmbedding y →
                      M ω ≤ ‖z.val‖ →
                      |g x - continuumGreen 2 (by decide) ⟨κ, hκ⟩ z - K y ω| ≤
                        C / Real.rpow ‖z.val‖ (1 - δ) := by
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ, htwo, _⟩ := hq 2 (by decide) p hp hp1
  obtain ⟨K, hKm, hK⟩ := htwo rfl
  refine ⟨κ, hκ, K, hKm, ?_⟩
  intro δ hδ
  obtain ⟨C, s, hC, hs, hbody⟩ := hK δ hδ
  refine ⟨C, s, hC, hs, ?_⟩
  intro y
  obtain ⟨hKt, M, hMm, hMn, hMt, hest⟩ := hbody y
  refine ⟨hKt, M, hMm, hMn, hMt, ?_⟩
  have hcols := ae_unique_green_column_for_all_poles hg hu 2 (by decide) p hp hp1
  filter_upwards [hcols, hest] with ω hcolsω hestω
  obtain ⟨h, hall⟩ := hcolsω
  refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
  intro hy
  obtain ⟨g, hgcol, hunique⟩ := hall h ⟨y, hy⟩
  exact ⟨g, ⟨hgcol, hestω h hy g hgcol⟩, fun g' hg' => hunique g' hg'.1⟩

theorem consume_three (hq : SupercriticalBondGreenQuantitative)
    (hg : SupercriticalBondGreenColumnExistence) (hu : SupercriticalBondUniqueness)
    (p : unitInterval) (hp : criticalProbability 3 < (p : ℝ)) (hp1 : (p : ℝ) < 1) :
    ∃ κ : ℝ, ∃ hκ : 0 < κ, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ C s : ℝ,
      0 < C ∧ 0 < s ∧ ∀ y : Vertex 3, ∃ M : Configuration 3 → ℝ,
        Measurable M ∧ (∀ ω, 0 ≤ M ω) ∧
        (∀ R : ℝ, 0 ≤ R → latticeBondLaw 3 p {ω | R ≤ M ω} ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal (C * Real.exp (-Real.rpow R s / C))) ∧
        ∀ᵐ ω ∂latticeBondLaw 3 p,
          ∃ h : HasUniqueInfiniteOpenComponent ω,
            ∀ hy : y ∈ (uniqueInfiniteComponent h).supp,
              ∃! g : uniqueInfiniteComponent h → ℝ,
                IsGreenColumn 3 (by decide) (uniqueInfiniteComponent h) ⟨y, hy⟩ g ∧
                ∀ x : uniqueInfiniteComponent h,
                  ∀ z : {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) // v ≠ 0},
                    z.val = latticeEuclideanEmbedding x.val - latticeEuclideanEmbedding y →
                    M ω ≤ ‖z.val‖ →
                    |g x - continuumGreen 3 (by decide) ⟨κ, hκ⟩ z| ≤
                      C / (Real.rpow ‖z.val‖ (1 - δ) * ‖z.val‖ ^ (3 - 2)) := by
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ, _, hthree⟩ := hq 3 (by decide) p hp hp1
  refine ⟨κ, hκ, ?_⟩
  intro δ hδ
  obtain ⟨C, s, hC, hs, hbody⟩ := hthree (by decide) δ hδ
  refine ⟨C, s, hC, hs, ?_⟩
  intro y
  obtain ⟨M, hMm, hMn, hMt, hest⟩ := hbody y
  refine ⟨M, hMm, hMn, hMt, ?_⟩
  have hcols := ae_unique_green_column_for_all_poles hg hu 3 (by decide) p hp hp1
  filter_upwards [hcols, hest] with ω hcolsω hestω
  obtain ⟨h, hall⟩ := hcolsω
  refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
  intro hy
  obtain ⟨g, hgcol, hunique⟩ := hall h ⟨y, hy⟩
  exact ⟨g, ⟨hgcol, hestω h hy g hgcol⟩, fun g' hg' => hunique g' hg'.1⟩

#print axioms consume_two
#print axioms consume_three
